borrow_debt_present.meaning: the Portfolio Margin account holds USDC borrow debt against eligible collateral

supplied_collateral_present.meaning: principal is bridged to HyperCore and held in Portfolio Margin supplied positions

reported_backing_nets_borrow.meaning: reported backing and surplus net out Portfolio Margin borrow debt so only real surplus is bridged and distributed as yield

usdm_undercollateralized.meaning: USDM becomes undercollateralized while the protocol still reports full backing

assumptions: The borrow debt and supplied collateral are both present in the same Portfolio Margin account before backing/surplus is computed.
The reported backing/surplus is derived from the Portfolio Margin account state via the accountant.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify borrow debt, supplied collateral, false surplus, or the resulting undercollateralization, so the netting relation is represented only by grounded Boolean observables.
Report does not state who triggers the borrow or whether it is attacker-controlled versus a normal vault operation.

limitations: Backing/surplus netting is encoded as a Boolean relation because no numeric amounts are supplied.
Only the usdm_undercollateralized impact is formalized; borrow socialization and false-yield distribution are not covered by this plan.
